mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return discount as investors anticipate rate hikes, leading to negative 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 2.0 for ≥3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index signals wage growth expectations, which, when combined with a falling UNRATE unemployment rate, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward return correlation in the interaction regime (Rank IC < 0.05), or UNRATE rises while PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption (≥2% YoY) suggests resilient demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite GDPC1 growth (t-test p < 0.05), or growth rate < 1% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 100 for ≥2 consecutive months, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for the first time in a month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be negative as investors anticipate tighter credit conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5 in the month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative during such events (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% for ≥2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in HOUST housing starts and a rise in PAYEMS employment suggests labor market balance, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases while PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in the interaction regime (Rank IC < 0.05), or HOUST rises while PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained period of falling RSAFS Treasury yields (monthly decline ≥2%), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days are expected to be positive as investors price in cheaper financing.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive despite RSAFS decline (p > 0.05), or RSAFS does not fall for ≥3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months and INDPRO remains flat, it indicates a supply-demand alignment that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 2 months and INDPRO unchanged
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day return during the regime (Rank IC < 0.05), or UNRATE rises above 4% while INDPRO is flat.
